title: Aftersales Services Engineer - Commercial Vehicle, Passenger Car, Off-Highway
desc:
Job description:
Aftersales Services Engineer - Commercial Vehicle, Passenger Car, Off-Highway
We are strengthening our team in Customer Service at our location in Istanbul/Sultanbeyli.
What you can look forward to as Aftersales Services Engineer:
Deliver ongoing technical support to authorized service centres and OEM’s
Analyse technical reports from authorized services and OEMs, provide technical guidance to services in collaboration with internal technical support teams
Communicate with customers based on headquarters feedback and reports received
Support joint technical projects with customers
Coordinate logistics for part shipments and returns of defective products
To follow up on warranty-related matters together with the warranty department and support the process of obtaining warranty approvals from related headquarter units
Install diagnostic devices, perform software updates, and manage related customer interactions
Coordinate and monitor external service technicians when needed
Your profile as Aftersales Services Engineer:
University degree in Engineering or a related technical field
At least 5 years of professional experience in automotive sector in similar position
Strong interpersonal, problem-solving, and solution-oriented skills with team oriented mindset
Basic computer literacy and active driving capability
High customer focus and service-oriented attitude
Proficient in both written and verbal communication in English
Why you should choose ZF in Istanbul:
Health Insurance
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus System
Monthly Heating Aid
Marriage, Birth, Annual Leave Allowance, and Gift Cards
The compatibility of work and family life is firmly anchored at ZF. For more information, please visit www.zf.com/berufundprivatleben.
